def.zh-tw: 對應角相等、對應邊成比例的兩個三角形；有兩組對應角相等（AA）就相似，對應邊的比叫做相似比。
def.en: Two triangles whose corresponding angles are equal and whose corresponding sides are in proportion; two pairs of equal corresponding angles (AA) are enough, and the common ratio of the sides is the ratio of similarity.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：相似三角形 similar triangles
